sections.description: Farmhouse Rental Theme is designed for websites that present rural stays, property details, accommodation options, and booking-related information in a structured layout. The theme can organize individual properties with images, descriptions, amenities, room details, pricing information, and availability sections. Its page layouts can be used to display essential accommodation information while keeping navigation straightforward. The design supports responsive viewing, allowing content to adapt to desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes. Custom sections can be arranged to highlight property features, nearby attractions, services, policies, and contact details. Image-focused layouts provide space for photographs of interiors, outdoor areas, landscapes, and facilities. The Farmhouse Rental theme can also include sections for testimonials, location information, inquiry forms, and calls to action, depending on the available configuration. Social media links and navigation menus can help connect visitors with additional information. Typography, colors, backgrounds, and other visual elements can be adjusted through the theme settings. Its structure provides a practical foundation for presenting farmhouse accommodation information and rental-related content in an organized format.
